text_block_list.text:
—The romance of dreaming. Forever chasing 
treasure waiting somewhere out in the 
world.

To Tap Dance City, that was only natural. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mirako~. Hey, Mirako, aren't you 
gonna run overseas or anything~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
An overseas campaign...? What do you mean, 
overseas campaign...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... So you've never even thought about 
that kind of thing.

For other Umamusume and ordinary people, 
that was by no means a given.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Still... her record is pretty decent, and 
if she really set her mind to it..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: No, no, no no no...

This Umamusume is Hishi Miracle. Back when 
she debuted, everyone regarded her as 
"just an ordinary Umamusume," but...

An unexpected longshot victory. And with 
it, a sudden GⅠ triumph.

She was truly a miraculous Umamusume who 
had suddenly leaped into the center of the 
era.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"In this world, you know, some things can 
be fixed with a miracle, and some things 
just can't."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing I can do about going 
overseas and stuff anyway.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Still, if only I could participate...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm telling you, I can't participate. 
For example, see, recently...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur-chan went to England, right? 
Even then, it wasn't like she went all by 
herself...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it seems her family is pretty 
wealthy. Apparently she managed to work 
things out thanks to that backing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume from the Symboli family and 
others race overseas too, but honestly, 
they can only do that because they're 
super rich...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day, an Umamusume can't 
race overseas without serious backing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Getting lucky and winning once or twice 
isn't going to change anything.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I seeee. Well, come to think of it, that 
makes total sense.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What!? Isn't that a little too boring?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tap-chan!
Just then, Tap Dance City came over.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Geez, don't say such depressing things. 
Acting like only the chosen few from the 
start get to race overseas.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have money, just scrape it 
together! What's wrong with climbing your 
way to the top?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it! Give it a shot and you can 
do anything! Right?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. Tap-chan, you're amazing. 
Unlike me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I never really think I can do it if I try, 
and even if I do, halfway through I end up 
thinking, 'No, no, there's no way...' 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Guess you just gotta do what you can, 
huh? And even so, you can still find some 
happiness, right?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Putting too much faith in the future only 
hurts more when things don't work out.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Believing too much hurts, huh... I 
can understand that feeling――"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I've forgotten how that feels. I threw 
that feeling into my hometown's 
Mississippi River ages ago, though.

Between Tap Dance City, who had constantly 
pushed beyond the everyday, and Hishi 
Miracle, who lived comfortably within it, 
there seemed to be a considerable 
difference in mindset.
The next day—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaaawn*... Tap-chan, what's up this 
early in the morning...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Morning practice is just impossible for 
me~.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hishi Miracle. Look at it――that sunrise.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Wake up, everybody! I wanna... change 
things. Wake up the minds of those who are 
still asleep."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Dreams come true. If you try, you can do 
it. If all that's out there are people who 
can't even believe in such obvious truths, 
then...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I figured I'd make them believe. Right, 
Trainer?

You can't gain anything without taking on 
the challenge. On that, we both agreed.

Wanting to dispel everyone's resignation— 
I can understand Tap Dance City's feelings 
on that very well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Changing everyone...? Th-that's wild... 
Way too high-minded for me to get, 
honestly...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Tap-chan... What are you going to 
do now to make them believe?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, listen up! First thing I'm gonna do 
is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "The Kinko Sho! I'm gonna win there!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And not only did she win, Silence Suzuka 
set down a legendary record!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll just win with an incredible run that 
blows past all of that. And blow the 
entire audience's minds away while I'm at 
it."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-chan's record... Isn't that the one 
they say will never be broken?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Can you really do that? Even for you, 
Tap-chan...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I can do it! And right after that is the 
main event!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Flying the banner of the strongest in the 
nation, I'm finally—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, the Arc!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeh... The Prix de l'Arc de... 
Triomphe?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Europe's greatest GⅠ. That 
unsinkable battleship that no one has ever 
managed to bring down...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll sink them myself! With these very 
hands, and these very legs!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawawa, Something no one has ever 
been able to do before, Tap-chan is just 
going and~.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. So first, come watch me in 
the Kinko Sho."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's where our grand voyage to the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe begins!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, got it... Honestly, any sleepiness 
I had just completely vanished...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... Prize 
of... Huh...?

Hishi Miracle walked away with a visible 
question mark practically floating over 
her head.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I kinda let it slip in the heat of 
the moment, but you don't mind, do you, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This is also a request from our sponsor 
who's lending us the base! We absolutely 
have to deliver!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"This autumn, I'm taking on France's 
greatest hurdle. Sounds good, doesn't 
it—the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'?"
choice_data_list: Yeah! I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: We can win this, you and me!

Running the numbers at top speed, I 
answer. "Distance," "running style," 
"schedule," and "budget"...

None of them have fatal flaws. Of course 
it won't be easy, but Tap Dance City 
really might...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Alright, alright, alriiiight, 
then let's go. This autumn, to France!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Bring all of your friends along!

Hearing those words... my mind went blank 
for a moment. It was a factor I hadn't 
seriously considered in reality.
Comrades... All of them... Comrades...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Huh? Is something wrong, Trainer...?"

I hurriedly hid my agitation. I didn't 
want to say anything that might pour cold 
water on her mood right now.

"An overseas expedition for the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe. In any case, I decided 
to do a bit more calculation regarding 
every single factor."
